IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CME6N5.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-ISSUER-RESPONSE       PIC X VALUE 'S'.
       01  WS-ONE-MONTH-CLOSED      PIC X VALUE 'N'.
       01  WS-OMBUDSMAN-AVAILABLE   PIC X VALUE 'N'.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       1000-MAIN.
           ACCEPT WS-ISSUER-RESPONSE
           ACCEPT WS-ONE-MONTH-CLOSED
           EVALUATE TRUE
             WHEN WS-ISSUER-RESPONSE NOT = 'S' AND
                  WS-ONE-MONTH-CLOSED = 'Y'
               MOVE 'Y' TO WS-OMBUDSMAN-AVAILABLE
             WHEN OTHER
               CONTINUE
           END-EVALUATE
           DISPLAY WS-OMBUDSMAN-AVAILABLE
           STOP RUN.
host_design_note: The complaint-month flag is a trusted upstream calendar-service abstraction; this fixture tests escalation policy, not date math.

authority.text: If a complainant does not get satisfactory response from the card-issuer within a maximum period of one month from the date of lodging the complaint, he/she will have the option to approach the Office of the concerned RBI Ombudsman.
If a complainant does not get a satisfactory response within a maximum period of 30 days from lodging the complaint, they may approach the RBI Ombudsman.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. BOP7A1.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-CAPITAL-PCT           PIC 9(3)V99 VALUE ZERO.
       01  WS-PROFIT-PCT            PIC 9(3)V99 VALUE ZERO.
       01  WS-IS-BO                 PIC X VALUE 'N'.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       1000-MAIN.
           ACCEPT WS-CAPITAL-PCT
           ACCEPT WS-PROFIT-PCT
           IF WS-CAPITAL-PCT > 15 OR WS-PROFIT-PCT > 15
              MOVE 'Y' TO WS-IS-BO
           END-IF
           DISPLAY WS-IS-BO
           STOP RUN.

authority.text: For partnership firms, the beneficial owner is the natural person with ownership of/entitlement to more than 10 percent of capital or profits (lowered from 15 percent by the 2023-10-17 amendment to the 2016 MD).

Where the customer is a partnership firm, the beneficial owner is the natural person(s), who, whether acting alone or together, or through one or more juridical person, has/have ownership of/entitlement to more than 15 per cent of capital or profits of the partnership.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. BOF3G7.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-CAPITAL-PERCENT      PIC 9(3)V99 VALUE ZERO.
       01  WS-PROFIT-PERCENT       PIC 9(3)V99 VALUE ZERO.
       01  WS-LARGEST-PERCENT      PIC 9(3)V99 VALUE ZERO.
       01  WS-OWNER-RESULT         PIC X VALUE 'N'.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       1000-MAIN.
           ACCEPT WS-CAPITAL-PERCENT
           ACCEPT WS-PROFIT-PERCENT
           IF WS-CAPITAL-PERCENT > WS-PROFIT-PERCENT
              MOVE WS-CAPITAL-PERCENT TO WS-LARGEST-PERCENT
           ELSE
              MOVE WS-PROFIT-PERCENT TO WS-LARGEST-PERCENT
           END-IF
           IF WS-LARGEST-PERCENT > 15
              MOVE 'Y' TO WS-OWNER-RESULT
           END-IF
           DISPLAY WS-OWNER-RESULT
           STOP RUN.

authority.text: Where the customer is a partnership firm, the beneficial owner is the natural person(s), who, whether acting alone or together, or through one or more juridical person, has/have ownership of/entitlement to more than 15 per cent of capital or profits of the partnership.

For partnership firms, the beneficial owner is the natural person with ownership of/entitlement to more than 10 percent of capital or profits (lowered from 15 percent by the 2023-10-17 amendment to the 2016 MD).

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. KYC7A1.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-PERIODIC-UPDATION    PIC X VALUE 'N'.
       01  WS-UPDATED-INFO-RECEIVED PIC X VALUE 'N'.
       01  WS-CUSTOMER-ID           PIC X(16) VALUE SPACES.
       01  WS-REGISTRY-STATUS       PIC X(8) VALUE 'NOT-SENT'.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       1000-MAIN.
           ACCEPT WS-PERIODIC-UPDATION
           ACCEPT WS-UPDATED-INFO-RECEIVED
           ACCEPT WS-CUSTOMER-ID
           IF WS-PERIODIC-UPDATION = 'Y' OR
              WS-UPDATED-INFO-RECEIVED = 'Y'
              PERFORM 2000-UPLOAD-REGISTRY
           END-IF
           DISPLAY WS-REGISTRY-STATUS
           STOP RUN.
       2000-UPLOAD-REGISTRY.
           IF WS-CUSTOMER-ID NOT = SPACES
              MOVE 'UPLOADED' TO WS-REGISTRY-STATUS
           END-IF.

authority.text: Regulated entities must update KYC records in the Central KYC Records Registry within 7 days of receiving updated information from a customer.

ABSENCE (old side is the absence of any update-deadline): clause (h) required uploading/updating KYC data at periodic updation or when updated information was received, with NO time-bound deadline. The seven-day sentence carries footnote 148: 'Inserted vide circular DOR.AML.REC.49/14.01.001/2024-25 dated November 6, 2024' - 'Inserted', not 'Amended': the sentence had no predecessor in any form.
